uncertainties.question: There is sufficient demand for healthy lunch options among office workers in the targeted Mumbai office parks.
Corporate clients are willing to commit to a minimum order volume of 150 meals per day per office park.
A cloud kitchen can produce and deliver a healthy lunch within 30 minutes of order placement at a cost below INR 120 per meal.
Regulatory approvals for operating a cloud kitchen in Mumbai (food license, fire safety, waste disposal) can be obtained within 4 weeks.
Office workers in Mumbai value nutrition and are willing to pay a premium for healthy meals.
Our team can secure a 200‑sq‑ft kitchen space within the pilot budget.
We have existing relationships with two office parks that can facilitate introductions to corporate HR contacts.
Delivery logistics can be handled by a third‑party partner with average delivery time under 20 minutes within the park.
